core_obligations: Show that every irreducible component of the source dominates the base, using connectedness and the unibranch hypothesis on the target.

proof_roadmap.step: Use the unibranch hypothesis on the target.
Show all components of the source dominate.

difficulty_reason: The lemma, attributed in the author's reference to SGA 1, proves that an unramified morphism with connected source, at least one component dominating the target, over an integral geometrically unibranch base, is etale and has irreducible source. The proof uses the unibranch hypothesis to control the local structure of the target, shows that every component of the source must dominate, and then concludes etaleness from unramifiedness plus flatness over the whole source. Using geometric unibranchness to force flatness is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 10510-10527.
